title: Harness Updating Is Not Harness Benefit: Disentangling Evolution Capabilities in Self-Evolving LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.30621v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as systems built around editable external harnesses, including prompts, skills, memories and tools, that shape task execution without changing model parameters. Harness self-evolution adapts such agents by updating these harnesses from execution evidence. Yet it remains unclear whether a model's base capability in task-solving predicts its capabilities in harness self-evolution: which models produce useful harness updates, and which actually benefit from them? We analyze two harness self-evolution capabilities: (i) harness-updating, the capability to produce useful persistent harness updates from execution evidence; (ii) harness-benefit, the capability to benefit from updated harnesses during task solving. translated_title: 框架更新不等于框架收益：解耦自进化大语言模型智能体中的进化能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被部署为围绕可编辑外部框架构建的系统，这些框架包括提示词、技能、记忆和工具，能够在不改变模型参数的情况下塑造任务执行方式。框架自进化通过从执行证据中更新这些框架来适配此类智能体。然而，模型在任务求解上的基础能力是否能预测其框架自进化能力，目前仍不清楚：哪些模型能够产生有用的框架更新，哪些模型又真正从中受益？我们分析了两种框架自进化能力：(i) 框架更新能力，即从执行证据中产生有用的持久性框架更新的能力；(ii) 框架收益能力，即在任务求解过程中从已更新的框架中受益的能力。我们的分析揭示了两个发现。首先，框架更新能力在不同基础能力层级之间是平坦的：来自不同能力层级的模型所产生的框架更新带来了惊人的相似收益……
tldr: 该研究将自进化大语言模型智能体的能力解耦为“框架更新”与“框架收益”两种，并发现模型产生有用框架更新的能力与其基础能力层级无关，不同能力的模型带来的更新收益惊人地相似，即擅长更新框架并不意味着能真正从中受益。
en_tdlr: This work disentangles two self-evolution capabilities in LLM agents—harness-updating and harness-benefit—and shows that harness-updating is flat across base capability tiers, meaning a model's ability to produce useful harness updates does not predict whether it actually benefits from them.
